text:
noah: prepping a sunrise minibatch maintenance for az3 on Sunday 04:00-06:00 UTC. Goal: address intermittent DMA recovery events by updating GPU microcode and NIC firmware. We'll use micro-batches to keep KV cache warm.

emma: what's the expected usable GPU delta at peak? any critical tenants to ping?

noah: ballpark 5-10% usable GPU drop while waves run. Affected pools: comet-az3, lumen-az3. We've listed 4 priority tenants in the runbook for targeted notices.

rajesh: propose 3-phase canary: single-rack soft reboot, then 2-rack cross-ToR pair, then minibatches of 1-2 racks. Keeps cold-hit small and surfaces switch-level regressions.

noah: agree. sequence: cordon -> evict noncritical -> soft-reboot -> smoke probes -> kv-sprinkle -> restore. Target ~7-9m per minibatch. First two canaries separated by different uplinks.

ops-bot: maintenance ticket created (#9055). 60m and 15m reminders scheduled.

emma: cost/egress: if we temporarily route heavy model routes to eu for 90m, what's our exposure?

rajesh: current az3 egress ~700GB/h. Routing to eu adds ~$0.10/GB. Worst-case ~700GB * 1.5h * 0.10 = ~$105. Add 20% buffer for retries -> ~$126. Label flows with maint=9055 for reconciliation.

finops-bot: noted. Approve up to $200 for this maintenance. Please tag telemetry with the maint label.

emma: failure criteria? smoke test thresholds?

rajesh: fail if gen/embed p99 > baseline*1.5 OR >1.5% error rate OR ToR-level packet loss spike. On fail: abort, uncordon last batch, revert routing weights, trigger emergency kv-sprinkle. Page infra lead.

noah: will set autoscaler max-surge +6% and increase scale-up aggressiveness for 15m after each successful minibatch. Also will add a temporary routing override for slo>=99.9 routes to prefer eu while the most aggressive minibatches run.

emma: please add a note to increase client timeout to 15s during the window to reduce retries.

noah: done. runbook snippet:
```
03:40 UTC - preflight: telemetry sanity, reserve 10% slots, notify tenants
04:00 - canary1 (rack-5) cordon -> soft-reboot -> smoke -> kv-sprinkle
04:15 - canary2 (rack-12, cross-ToR) repeat
04:35 - minibatches across racks (~7-9m each)
05:50 - final sweep, de-cordon, postflight metrics
```

rajesh: smoke tests owners: embeddings p99 -> emma, generation sample -> rajesh. I'll post the smoke snapshots here during the run.

ops-bot: 15m preflight notice will post to #oncall and tenant channels.

emma: small ops ask: tag any temporary cross-region egress with label "maint=9055" and include a tracing header for request attribution.

finops-bot: confirmed. We'll reconcile after the window. Alert if forecasted spend > $200.

noah: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/az3/minibatch-9055 (check preflight checklist). Opening calendar invite and assigning owners now. Ping here if anything looks risky. :rocket:
